Summary

  • Systematic macro portfolio. Styles include trend, carry, relative value.
  • Products span liquid ETFs and futures across asset classes.
  • Walk-forward backtest, taker economics. Signal uses time t-1 info for decision at time t.
  • Trading decisions combine regime information with conditional mean and volatility forecasts.
  • Results shown net of bid/ask costs, exchange fees, commissions, 3M T-Bills.
  • Sharpe ratios annualized, from daily returns; monthly where a benchmark is monthly.
  • Per-sleeve median holding periods range from under one session to 76 sessions.

Backtest Performance

Risk and Drawdown Profile

  • Positive tail days slightly outnumber negative tail days (29 vs 21).
  • Highest pairwise sleeve correlation across years is +0.34 (2022, FX trend × Rates RV)
  • Lowest pairwise sleeve correlation is Core trend × FX trend in six of nine years (−0.32 to −0.50). FX sleeve’s USD long beta offsets USD short beta from core’s dollar-denominated assets.

Factor Exposure

Costs and Capacity

  • Sharpe falls 0.05 at 2x assumed bid/ask, 0.47 at 10x assumed bid/ask.
  • Square-root impact model costs 0.03–0.06 of Sharpe (can be mitigated via order pacing).
  • ETF legs capped at 5% of closing auction volume.

Crisis Alpha

  • Windows are the five deepest 60/40 drawdowns, month-end peak to trough. Book finishes above 60/40 in all five; BTOP50 is positive in one (2022).
